name: Disable Dynamic Tick
description: Disables Dynamic Tick to keep system timer behavior more consistent, which may help with latency and responsiveness on some systems.

description_i18n.en: Disables Dynamic Tick to keep system timer behavior more consistent, which may help with latency and responsiveness on some systems.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die dynamische Taktung für ein konsistenteres Systemverhalten und kann bei manchen Geräten Latenz oder Reaktionszeit verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le Dynamic Tick pour un comportement horlogiste plus cohérent, ce qui peut améliorer la latence et la réactivité sur certains systèmes.

warnings.title: Boot configuration modified
warnings.message: This tweak updates boot configuration values that affect startup behavior

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the Windows boot configuration by setting or removing the disabledynamictick registry value
